actions.action: Water only when soil is completely dry, soak thoroughly and let excess drain
Move plants to brightest spot (south/west window), gradually acclimating over 1-2 weeks
Use a sheer curtain if sun is harsh
Unpot and check roots and stems for rot
Cut off mushy, black or brown roots
Repot in fresh cactus/succulent mix or amended soil in pot with drainage holes if soil is dense and damp
Take cuttings of healthy rosettes/stems, callus 2-3 days, place on dry mix
Lay fallen leaves on dry soil to root

reason: The answer identifies low light and overwatering as the main problems and advises thorough but infrequent watering only when dry plus brighter light, matching the confirmed fix with nothing harmful.
